children: Costco is finding success in the Korean beauty products category, Chief Financial Officer Gary Millerchip tells investors on a call. Health and beauty was among the company's top-performing non-food departments in the fiscal fourth quarter, he says. "Our success in health and beauty is a great example of our buyers identifying global trends and sourcing new items that resonate strongly with our members," Millerchip says. "Some of the best performing items this quarter included K-beauty products such as face masks and lotions from a number of top Korean vendors." (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
